verdict.rationale: First-party docs confirm Mixpanel ships Session Replay for watching real user sessions to see why customers drop off. They also document UI-managed sampling, saved replay playlists and AI summaries across replays. Nothing in the evidence addresses masking of sensitive input, by default or otherwise, so only half the story is shown. Missing for 10: documented default masking of sensitive inputs/PII in replays, privacy controls for replay capture, independent or hands-on corroboration of replay quality.
